notes: True homograph of the existing H3738 (כרה¹, "dig; buy"), both spelled כרה -- added as כרה² per the ascending-Strong's-number superscript convention; H3738 is retroactively renamed כרה¹ in this same batch. Strong's own lexicon calls H3739 "probably only a special application of 3738" (same historical root, split number) -- H3738's notes already anticipated this root being added separately, see its updated notes.
Gloss collision: shares "trade" with the existing סחר (H5503, "go around; trade") -- distinct roots, disambiguating search alias added.
